name: Runner Extras - Precompiled Async Subscriber
brief: Issue #2932: a PRECOMPILED app's table-event [EventSubscriber] is emitted as an async ValueTask method, and the runner must observe that ValueTask so the subscriber body runs to completion.
description: Runner-mechanism claim, not a claim about AL. What Base Application codeunit 9002 does on User/OnBeforeModifyEvent is plain BC behaviour and needs no corpus test. What this pins is the runner's own dispatch: EventSubscriberPatches builds every injected NavEventSubscription with memberId 0, which sends BC's CallEventSubscriberInternalAsync down the reflection branch that DISCARDS the return value. Every Base App / System App subscriber measured on BC 28.1 returns ValueTask, so the body started, suspended at its first await and was abandoned - BC's own NoOfCalls counter recorded the call while the Error() the subscriber existed to raise never reached the caller and the write went through. A source-compiled subscriber in the bundle under test is emitted void, so it was unaffected, which is why the defect read as 'precompiled subscribers never fire'.
